summary: Rentokil Initial plc filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a London Stock Exchange announcement) disclosing open-market purchases of its own ordinary shares. Between 27 and 30 October 2026, the Company bought 1,855,225 shares via Goldman Sachs International on the LSE under the buyback authority granted at the 7 May 2026 AGM, at volume-weighted prices of roughly 3.4288 to 3.5121 per share. All purchased shares will be cancelled, leaving 2,524,184,660 ordinary shares in issue and none held in treasury. What to watch: buyback pace and any change to the standing repurchase mandate.
